Aisha: heads-up: after yesterday's RBAC cleanup someone noticed a bunch of orphaned service accounts in tenant 'delta-inc' and SCIM deprovision logs are missing for ~20 users. any idea if this is SCIM or our KMS rotation?
Jon: which logs are missing? audit log viewer or our internal provisioning traces?
Aisha: both. Admins saw 'deprovision requested' in UI but no corresponding outbound SCIM request to idp. audit-log shows local event but payload encryption step failed in the worker.
Tomas: was the KMS rewrap job run last night? I remember we rotated the envelope key and rewrapped extids earlier.
kevin: kms-bot: rewrap job INF-9007 completed at 1829996000, 0 errors reported.
kms-bot: "Rewrap job INF-9007: Completed. 0 failures. Wrapped-key-version v3 -> v4."
Jon: if worker failed to decrypt extid, it might have skipped building the SCIM payload and just emitted an audit event. Check worker logs for KMS decrypt errors around 1829998000-1829999500.
Aisha: tail from worker: "error decrypting extid: kms:Decrypt failed: invalid envelope format" repeated ~22x.
Tomas: that suggests some objects were rewrapped with a different algorithm (OAEP params) or older ciphertext format. Did the rewrap tool change the JWE alg/enc?
kevin: rewrap tool updated to use new key-alias and default rsa-oaep-256, but we didn't set explicit enc param; old keys used rsa-oaep. ops ticket INF-9012 mentions this.
Jon: short mitigation: add a decode fallback in worker: try rsa-oaep then rsa-oaep-256 and if decrypt fails emit a fatal alert so we don't silently skip SCIM. Also requeue affected extids for rewrap with an explicit compat flag.
Aisha: if we requeue, we should also replay SCIM deprov requests for delta-inc. Can someone export the list?
Tomas: I can script a requeue: query audit events where deprov requested AND no outbound scim entry; push to rewrap queue + mark for replay.
kevin:I'll open INF-9033 to track: rewrap-compat-fallback, worker hard-fail on decrypt, replay deprov, and run a one-off migration to normalize extid enc params.
Aisha: thanks. Add runbook note: after any KMS rewrap, validate worker decrypts with both alg variants and check sample tenant repro fully end-to-end (audit->decrypt->scim outbound).
Jon: also add a monitoring alert: if audit events >0 and scim-outbound=0 for same change_id within 5m, alert paging. That would have caught this earlier.
Aisha: agreed. I'll attach example worker logs and list of affected users to INF-9033 and schedule a postmortem. :white_check_mark:
